scope: Linux dedicated hwmon temperature/fan collection, GUI worker contracts and bounded CLI JSONL; not an installation, real fan lease or physical cooling/noise acceptance
implemented: Service::sample_thermal shares the existing hwmon collector; it does not discover OEM controls, brightness, power profiles or catalogue entries and launches no external commands
Canonical input identities and class-alias deduplication remain; missing/invalid/removed readings stay unknown rather than becoming zero or a prior sample

suspended/suspending/resuming/error pre-read runtime PM observations skip input and label opens; active/unsupported/absent attributes retain reads; the observation is not a PM lock or a firmware freshness guarantee
ThermalSample uses process-local Instant read bounds; bounded CLI JSONL adds UTC frame bounds and collection duration without claiming atomic or firmware-fresh samples
Clean GUI refresh can update battery/AC; Linux pending previews and fan sessions keep only temperature/RPM sampling, preserving confirmation; Windows pending previews pause automatic sampling
Immutable catalogue parsing and normalized search index are cached through OnceLock<Result>; invalid data retains a real error rather than an Ok empty cache
RGB keyboard arrow steps use exactly one complete byte; three isolated regressions detect restored old input/sampling/error-loss behavior

rust.test_count_scope: One complete workspace total, not a thermal-only count or a per-feature count
rust.windows: x86_64-pc-windows-gnu compile check only; dedicated Windows thermal backend remains unavailable

isolated_regressions.scope: Only isolated copies; each selected production regression executed and failed its assertion, not a compiler/format failure

actual_cli.cpu_scope: CLI and strace overhead, not GUI/whole-host utilization

native_gui_qa.termination_scope: SIGTERM and process reaping only; not native graceful-close evidence

visual_review.method: Both original 1280x720 PNGs inspected with view_image.
visual_review.overview: Device heading, compact thermal card, collection-start age/duration, actual CPU/GPU temperature, fan RPM, trend endpoints/time range, separate device-info timestamp and spaced lower controls are visible without overlap. Lower dashboard content continues below the viewport.
visual_review.fans: Four separate Tab events and Return visibly selected Fans. Initial unprobed interface, import affordance and absent-draft explanation are visible. No invented curve or applied state. Further actions continue below viewport.
visual_review.startup: gui-app.log is empty; app stayed alive for both captures.
visual_review.compositor_notes: Headless cage logged an INFO-level unavailable DRM lease manager and a bus-connection message during teardown; no application startup error or panic was logged.

limitations: Native Linux headless compositor with software rendering; this is not the actual user desktop or Windows runtime.
Only startup and read-only keyboard navigation were performed. No fan interface probe, lease acquisition, Apply, Restore, actuator write or service change was requested.
SIGTERM termination after capture proves process reaping, not graceful native close behavior.
No fan acoustics, cooling effect, hardware parity or DPI beyond the captured 1280x720 scene is claimed.
